purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0043 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出说话人下一步会先做什么。
front.task_prompt: 先定位下一步计划信号，再按连接词区分第一步和后续安排。

options.text: Contact three potential partners this week.
Arrange a joint demo before contacting anyone.
Wait for partners to plan the meeting first.
Cancel the demo because no partner has replied.

task_schema.focus: 下一步信号 + 动作顺序
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分优先动作、后续动作和条件限制

audio.transcript: My next step is to contact three potential partners this week and then arrange a joint demo meeting if they respond positively.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。这句话的计划链是：先 contact three potential partners this week，再在对方回应积极时 arrange a joint demo meeting。B 把顺序倒过来；C 把主动计划误读成等待别人安排；D 把条件句误解成取消计划。后续计划题要先抓 next step，再看 then 和 if 限定。
tips: next step 通常直接引出下一步动作。
then 后面的动作要和第一步区分顺序。
if 条件限制的是后续安排，不是否定第一步。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 next step 引出的第一步计划

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力推理题中按动作顺序还原说话人的下一步计划。

front.text: 听完后，选出最可能发生的后续变化。
front.task_prompt: 先判断可能性信号强度，再把例外条件和主结论分开。

options.text: The launch will definitely be cancelled.
The launch will be moved forward by two weeks.
The launch will probably be delayed by about one week.
The launch date will remain unchanged no matter what.

task_schema.focus: 可能性信号 + 条件限制
task_schema.success_criteria: 能选出高概率结果，同时避免把条件句绝对化

audio.transcript: Given the testing backlog, we are likely to postpone the launch by roughly a week unless extra engineers join the team.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。Given the testing backlog 给出原因，we are likely to postpone the launch by roughly a week 给出最可能后果。A 把 postpone 误读成 cancel，且 definitely 过于绝对；B 与 postpone 方向相反；D 忽略了 likely to postpone 和 backlog。unless extra engineers join the team 只说明有条件可能避免延期。
tips: likely to 是可能性强的推理信号。
unless 后面常给出例外条件，不要改写成无条件结论。
推理题要警惕 definitely、no matter what 这类绝对化选项。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 根据 likely to 和 unless 判断可能后果

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户在后续可能题中保留语气强度和条件限制，避免把可能性听成绝对事实。

front.text: 听完后，选出团队接下来要做的计划组合。
front.task_prompt: 先区分已完成背景和计划触发句，再保留后续计划中的并列动作。

options.text: Redesign the onboarding flow and test it with new users.
Stop the onboarding project for new users.
Release the current flow without further testing.

task_schema.action: 四选一：计划触发句匹配
task_schema.focus: 背景句 + 计划触发句 + 并列动作
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把已经发生的信息和真正的下一步计划分开

audio.transcript: We have collected enough user feedback. The next thing we will do is redesign the onboarding flow and test it with new users.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。前一句 We have collected enough user feedback 是已完成背景；真正的计划触发信号是 The next thing we will do is，后面连续给出 redesign the onboarding flow 和 test it with new users 两个动作。A 复述背景，C 与原文相反，D 漏掉 test it with new users。
tips: have collected 这类完成时常提示背景已经发生。
The next thing we will do is 后面通常就是答案核心。
计划组合题要把并列动作一起保留。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 区分已完成背景和 next thing 引出的下一步计划

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户从背景句切换到计划句，完整保留后续计划中的并列动作。
